RX 9070 GRE | 12 GB: was $569.99 now $499.99
The RX 9070 GRE is the latest entry in AMD's RX 9000-series, and for the money, you're getting a great mid-range graphics card. If it stays at this price, then it will be the sensible choice over the 16 GB RTX 5060 Ti. Let's hope that there's enough supply, as stocks are already looking a bit thin. Sign into a free Newegg account to see the full discount.
Key specs: 3072 shaders | 2920 MHz boost | 12 GB GDDR6
RX 9070 GRE price check: Amazon $549.99 | Best Buy $549.99 | Walmart $569.99View Deal

I highlighted this deal as one of the best value graphics card deals on the block last week and, inconceivably, it's become even cheaper now I've checked through all the GPU deals today. That's thanks to the Newegg discount giving you $70 off the listing price. That means it's even more true today that, for PC gamers looking to get the most frame rate bang for their buck, an AMD GPU is the only silicon worth the money right now. And the Radeon RX 9000-series family is also the only one of the current generation to be able to offer a pretty high-end graphics card for under its MSRP.

I give you, once more, the Radeon RX 9070 GRE, a 12 GB card you can pick up today for just $500 at Newegg. The one minor caveat is that you will need to have a Newegg account to be able to see the full discount—just enter the email address you use to create the free account and you'll see an extra $70 lopped off the original $570 price tag.
Join us on WhatsApp for daily deals, direct to your phone.

The most obvious Nvidia-shaped competition for AMD's most recent RDNA 4 GPU is the RTX 5070 12 GB and the RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB. And the absolute cheapest (and trustworthy) prices I've found for those two GeForce cards are $779 and $780 respectively. The RTX 5070 is generally the more performant card, offering slightly higher frame rates. But that's the key here; the frame rate delta is pretty small, especially when you start to bring in upscaled 1440p performance into the picture.

RX 9070 GRE | 12 GB: was $569.99 now $499.99
The RX 9070 GRE is the latest entry in AMD's RX 9000-series, and for the money, you're getting a great mid-range graphics card. If it stays at this price, then it will be the sensible choice over the 16 GB RTX 5060 Ti. Let's hope that there's enough supply, as stocks are already looking a bit thin. Sign into a free Newegg account to see the full discount.

Key specs: 3072 shaders | 2920 MHz boost | 12 GB GDDR6

RX 9070 GRE price check: Amazon $549.99 | Best Buy $549.99 | Walmart $569.99View Deal

I highlighted this deal as one of the best value graphics card deals on the block last week and, inconceivably, it's become even cheaper now I've checked through all the GPU deals today. That's thanks to the Newegg discount giving you $70 off the listing price. That means it's even more true today that, for PC gamers looking to get the most frame rate bang for their buck, an AMD GPU is the only silicon worth the money right now. And the Radeon RX 9000-series family is also the only one of the current generation to be able to offer a pretty high-end graphics card for under its MSRP.

I give you, once more, the Radeon RX 9070 GRE, a 12 GB card you can pick up today for just $500 at Newegg. The one minor caveat is that you will need to have a Newegg account to be able to see the full discount—just enter the email address you use to create the free account and you'll see an extra $70 lopped off the original $570 price tag.

Join us on WhatsApp for daily deals, direct to your phone.

The most obvious Nvidia-shaped competition for AMD's most recent RDNA 4 GPU is the RTX 5070 12 GB and the RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB. And the absolute cheapest (and trustworthy) prices I've found for those two GeForce cards are $779 and $780 respectively. The RTX 5070 is generally the more performant card, offering slightly higher frame rates. But that's the key here; the frame rate delta is pretty small, especially when you start to bring in upscaled 1440p performance into the picture.
